title: Bilingual Screening Interview - Valeria Beltrán
summary: Valeria Beltrán interviewed for Bilingual Commercial Underwriter position. Demonstrated 5 years experience handling US trucking accounts, fluency in commercial English (C1 CEFR), and strong knowledge of balance sheet debt reconciliation.
action_items: Schedule Case Study with Robert Martinez
full_transcript_text:
[00:00:02] Elena Ramos: Good afternoon Valeria. Welcome to the initial screening session for the Commercial Underwriting role at nuDesk Mazatlán Hub.
[00:00:15] Valeria Beltrán: Thank you Elena. I am very excited about this opportunity. For the past five years, I have been analyzing financial statements, tax returns, and debt schedules for logistics operators in the US Southwest.
[00:00:45] Elena Ramos: Could you tell me how you handle cases where an applicant attempts to hide secondary MCA debt or factoring liens?
[00:01:05] Valeria Beltrán: Absolutely. In daily bank statement reconciliations, I immediately look for repeated daily or weekly ACH debits with codes like 'MCA', 'CAP', or 'FND'. Even if not disclosed on the debt schedule, the cash ledger never lies.
[00:01:30] Elena Ramos: That is precisely what we look for.
